proved_step: LEMMA EPS-UNIFORM (CLAIMED, needs review). Let c in [0,1) and eta := (1-c)/2. Assume (A) CJW20 Thm 1.6 as stated in PNP-001-LIT-4-2026-11-20.md: for fixed beta>0 and eta>0, MCSP[N^beta] has no probabilistic formulas of size N^{2+beta-eta} for all sufficiently large N (threshold N_0 may depend on beta and eta); and (B) R-MCSP reuse bound L(MCSP[N^beta]) <= K CC^{1+c} for some constant K. Then for all sufficiently large N, CC(MCSP[N^beta]) >= (N^{2+beta-eta}/K)^{1/(1+c)} >= N^{eps(c)}/K^{1/(1+c)}, where eps(c) = (2-eta)/(1+c) - 1 = (1-c)/(2(1+c)) > 0, and eps(c) does not depend on beta. Proof: from (A), L >= N^{2+beta-eta}; from (B), CC^{1+c} >= L/K; take the (1+c)-th root; since beta > 0, 2+beta-eta >= 2-eta = (3+c)/2, and (3+c)/(2(1+c)) = 1 + eps(c). Scope: exponent bookkeeping only; uniformity of the threshold N_0 in beta is NOT claimed. Note: the earlier exclusion of eta >= beta in the finite check was unnecessary, since Thm 1.6 holds for any eps > 0.

proved_step: LEMMA WINDOW (CLAIMED, needs review; kind LEMMA, bookkeeping, no new lower bound). Let beta in (0,1), c in [0,1+beta). Let eps := (1+beta-c)/2 > 0. Assume (A') CJW20 Thm 1.6 (PNP-001-LIT-4-2026-11-20.md, Def 2.1: N = truth-table length, L = leaves): for alpha=beta and this eps, L_prob(MCSP[N^beta]) >= N^(2+beta-eps) for all N >= N_0(beta,eps). Deterministic formulas are a special case of probabilistic ones, so the bound applies to the deterministic L used in the R-MCSP chain. Assume (B_c) L(MCSP[N^beta]) <= K * CC^(1+c) for all large N. PROOF: CC^(1+c) >= L/K >= N^(2+beta-eps)/K, so CC >= N^(e)/K^(1/(1+c)) with e = (2+beta-eps)/(1+c). Since c < 1+beta-eps (by choice of eps), e > 1, so CC >= N^(1+delta) for delta = e-1 > 0 and large N. CONSEQUENCES: (i) the target exponent c = 1-delta' < 1 lies in [0,1+beta), so for the R-MCSP target the second lever (a(beta) > 2+beta) is NOT needed; (ii) with a general fixed-threshold exponent a(beta), the same argument covers exactly c < a(beta)-1, so the second lever is needed only for c in [1+beta, a-1). SHARPNESS: for c >= 1+beta, e <= 1 for every eps>0 and the argument yields nothing; so the window is exactly c < 1+beta under CJW20. Scope: exponent bookkeeping plus one source-checked hypothesis (A'); it does not prove (B_c) for any c, which is the open obligation of Q-142b3d067f (semantic property P).
